description: This file defines the AppointmentService class, providing methods to interact with 'appointments' data in a backend database via the SupabaseService. It includes methods to list appointments for patients and doctors, get appointments by ID, create, update, and cancel appointments.

classes.name: AppointmentService
classes.description: A service class providing CRUD operations for appointment data in a healthcare app.

methods.name: listForPatient
methods.description: Retrieves a list of appointments for a specific patient, ordered by start time.

methods.name: listForDoctor
methods.description: Retrieves a list of appointments for a specific doctor, ordered by start time.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a single appointment by its unique ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new appointment record in the database.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Sets the appointment status to 'cancelled' for a given appointment ID.
